title: PeacefullER
description: A fuller peaceful experience. Adds everything vanilla that's missing from peaceful mode, with a few quality of life touches~
body:
**This pack adds back every vanilla item that is missing from peaceful mode, allowing you to make everything, and go everywhere, including The End!**

There are also a handful of quality of life tweaks for players that enjoy a chill resource gathering and building experience.

(This is made for the peaceful gamemode, but I don't see why you couldn't try it on other gamemodes if you want as well.)

# Changes

### Items!
- **Blaze Rods**: Now found in Nether Fortress chests, and piglin trades! **Now you can access The End in Peaceful!**
- **Ender Pearls**: Now also found in Bastion chests, and End City chests! Trading with piglins is more likely to give pearls as well.
- **Nether Star**: Now found in End City chests.
- **Dragon Breath**: Now found in End City chests.
- **Ghast Tears**: Now in Bastion chests, and piglin trades.
- **Sea Lanterns**: They drop themselves now!
- **Prismarine Shards**: Found in Ocean Ruin chests and through fishing.
- **Tridents**: Found in Ocean Ruin chests, and can be fished.
- **Slime Balls**: Can now be fished! _Fishing in swamps gets WAY more slime and junk._
- **Froglights**: Smelt a Shroomlight to get an Ochre Froglight. Dye them with Green, Purple, and Yellow dyes to get all the colors.
- **Music Discs**: All music discs that can't be found elsewhere can now be found in dungeon chests.
- **Gunpowder**: Can be crafted with Sand and Charcoal (NOT Coal).
- **String**: Can be crafted from wool.
- **Chainmail Armor**: Can be crafted with chains.

### Quality of Life
- **Diamond and Netherite tools are unbreakable!** No need for mending or unbreaking.
- **Diamond and Netherite armor and Elytra are automatically given Mending and Unbreaking III** when equipped!
- **Keep Inventory** is on.
- **Fire Tick** is off.
- **Lava Source Conversion** is on, meaning two sources make a third, like with water.
- **Random Tick Speed** is set to 25. More convenient for a variety of processes without being too fast.
- **Breeding now only has a cooldown of 1 min** instead of 5, and babies grow in 4 instead of 20.
- **Only One Player needs to sleep** for the night to pass.
- **The Ender Dragon is automatically defeated** upon entering The End. You can still summon another if you desire, but it won't hurt you. You can gather more dragon breath from it.
